plugins.name: gtdbrain
plugins.description: Getting Things Done (GTD) board for Claude. Capture what's on your mind straight to your Inbox, pull up next actions by context, keep projects and Waiting For honest, and run a proper weekly review — on the same board as the GTD Brain web, iOS, and Android apps. Bundles GTD Brain's hosted MCP server (sign in with an email code, no API key) plus GTD skills and slash commands.

skills.name: capture
skills.description: Capture one or more things to the user's GTD Brain Inbox. Use when the user says "capture", "add to my inbox", "remind me to", "I need to", or lists things on their mind.

skills.name: gtd
skills.description: How to run the user's Getting Things Done (GTD) board through the GTD Brain tools. Use whenever the user mentions something they need to do, remember, or follow up on, asks what to work on, wants to clarify their inbox, review projects, chase people they are waiting on, or run a weekly review.
headings: First contact and the free allowance

skills.name: inbox-zero
skills.description: Process the user's GTD Brain Inbox to zero, clarifying every card into a next action, project, waiting-for, someday, or archive. Use when the user wants to clarify, triage, or empty their inbox.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Check that GTD Brain is connected and signed in, and walk the user through connecting if it is not. Use right after installing the plugin, when GTD Brain tools are missing, or when a tool answers with an authentication error.
headings: B — The tool is not available, or the call fails with 401 / "authentication required"

skills.name: waiting-for
skills.description: Review the user's Waiting For list, flag stale delegated items, and create follow-up actions. Use when the user asks who they are waiting on, wants to chase people, or before a weekend or deadline.

skills.name: weekly-review
skills.description: Run the user's GTD weekly review in three phases — Get Clear, Get Current, Get Creative — reading every list with a tool. Use when the user asks for a weekly review or wants to get their whole system current.

skills.name: what-now
skills.description: Pick the next actions that fit where the user is right now. Use when the user asks what to do, what to work on, or says where they are or how much time they have.
